title: Circular microscope field showing many spherical droplets
objects_and_counts: No people are visible in the photographed scene.

Within the circular field there are many discrete spherical objects (droplets or beads) of varying diameters; these are present across the entire visible field.
Some of the spherical objects are visibly larger (several distinct larger spheres) and many more are smaller, including numerous very small spheres clustered between larger ones.
